market_position.notes: A1 Croatia is the #2 operator behind market leader Hrvatski Telekom (Deutsche Telekom subsidiary). Mobile market share trend (HAKOM, official regulator data, by subscribers): end-2024 HT 44.4% / A1 34.1% / Telemach 21.5%, out of ~4.7m total mobile subscribers in Croatia (+3.4% YoY). The Q1 2025 figure of ~33.8% and the 2025 estimate of ~34.1% are consistent continuations of this trend; an earlier conflicting ~20% A1 share figure appears erroneous and is discarded. End-2024 subscriber base ~2.1m (+4.1% YoY, implying ~2.0m end-2023), of which ~0.7m fixed-line RGUs (+0.1% YoY) (A1 Group FY2024 results report, March 2025). FY2023 mobile subscriber growth +2.8% with ARPU +6%. 2023 spectrum auction investment: A1 Hrvatska EUR 109.3m vs HT EUR 135.3m and Telemach EUR 94.4m. Convergence (mobile + cable/fixed broadband bundling) remains A1's key differentiator; FTTH passed ~409k households (2024), >672k premises on gigabit broadband, 5G covers 98% of Croatia, 5G Standalone live in Zagreb, Split, Rijeka and key tourist routes; 5G Homebox (FWA) coverage ~92% (late 2025/early 2026). HAKOM reports the overall Croatian electronic communications market generated EUR 1.8bn revenue in 2024, with EUR 427m total operator investment (mobile portion EUR 116.2m, +26% YoY).
